# miniz (vendored)

This directory contains the upstream miniz sources used by the Steins host
tests. It replaces the former `tests/vendor/miniz/up` gitlink, which could not
be fetched reproducibly because the repository has no `.gitmodules` entry for
it.

- Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz
- Tag: `3.1.0`
- Commit: `174573d60290f447c13a2b1b3405de2b96e27d6c`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

`miniz_export.h` is the standard empty export-header shim generated for
non-Windows builds of the upstream project.
